context:
# Goal
Round 17 coverage/provenance audit for kengaku. Sole L1 owns integration; this is an unjudged advisory wave, never Rust judgment or outside non-author promotion/learning review.
# Contract
Only writable repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kengaku-shokunin. Read plans/wwkd-round-17-coverage.md. Each member may write ONLY its uniquely named report under .ufo/round-17/wave/members/; all shared files remain parent-owned. No delegation, child workers, background jobs, commits or pushes. Skip builds/lint/tests/formatters and runtime checks; L1 runs all acceptance after integration. No external network, endpoint traffic, config/auth/host/package changes, native transcript bodies, raw journals, credentials/oauth/server.token or environment values. Historical experiment bytes are immutable. Source absence is exact-path/capture-time, not global; retained digests are not originals. Cite file:line and distinguish observed/inferred/unverified. Report substantive contradictions, safe correction, and claim limits; no filler, no invented success.
# Baseline
3f31e54c6e7aeddef13db11985b3c7a9dad9e0cf; inherited nine-seat round13-coverage artifacts are historical/noncompliant with the current wave shape. Current effective role routing is unresolved; this payload must NOT be dispatched until host-authorized @m_grok audit routes and @m_antigravity connector with @m_zfl fallback are actually bound. Do not repair routing yourself.
milestone: source availability and exact discoverability audit
